# piggy-act-v1 conformance vectors (piggy RFC 0013, "Conformance Testing").
#
# Replayed by crates/piggy/src/act/tests.rs from its copy at
# crates/piggy/testdata/0013-vectors.txt (the nix source of the piggy crate
# holds crates/ only); `just lint-worktree` fails when the copy drifts.
#
# Records are separated by blank lines. Each line is "key: value", except
# that a document is written one line per "| " line (the text after "| " is
# the line, and a lone "|" is an empty line); every document line ends in
# LF. Keys:
#
#   name          record name
#   outcome       canonical | refuse
#   document      the input (as "| " lines)
#   body-hex      lowercase hex appended to "document": body bytes a "| "
#                 line cannot carry (control characters, invalid UTF-8)
#   canonical     (canonical) the canonical form, RFC 0013 §3.1
#   sealed        (canonical, sealed acts) the sealed canonical form, §3.5
#   rule          (refuse) the rule that refuses it, as `piggy act canon`
#                 names it: envelope | type | type-lock | line-kind |
#                 quoted-field-name | duplicate-field | unknown-field |
#                 missing-field | forbidden-field | value | body
#
# Every key, digest and signature is a markl test value (a 0x00, 0x01, ...
# payload); none verifies. Seal verification has its own vectors.

name: canonical/root-already-canonical
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| # root: operator blesses session 72dca00c
| - kind = root
| - producer = troupe:root-v1
| - subject = clown:72dca00c
| - subject-key = piggy-principal_pub-v1@ssh_ed25519_pub-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0str2nnx
| - issuer = operator
| - issuer-key = piggy-piv_sig-v1@ssh_ecdsa_nistp256_pub-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0jq03gaxg
| - right = spinclass:check
| - right = spinclass:merge
| - records = piggy-record-digest-v1@blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| - not-after = 2026-11-09T23:00:00Z
| - issued-at = 2026-11-08T23:00:00Z
| - assurance = piggy:hardware
| - key = piggy-piv_sig-v1@ssh_ecdsa_nistp256_pub-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0jq03gaxg
| - namespace = piggy-certificate-v1
| - hash = sha256
| - spinclass:profile = dev
| ! piggy-act-v1

name: refuse/right-on-an-approval
outcome: refuse
rule: forbidden-field
document:
| ---
